name: io.chainchoice/rankings
title: ChainChoice published rankings
description: Read-only ChainChoice rankings: sourced, dated comparisons of crypto services, with evidence.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category ChainChoice ranks, with how many products it ranks, how many it assessed and left out with a reason, its leader, and its page; and notRanked, the categories not ranked right now (no order, no rank: get_ranking answers each with its line, reason, dates and the products it tracks A to Z).

tools.name: get_ranking
tools.description: The published order of one category: rank, product id, name and ChainChoice Score, with the methodology version, the dimension weights and what was assessed. The same order the category page and rankings.json publish. `followUps`: the follow-ups the search bars offer under this list (why not the #2, the top two side by side), each as words the search tool reads; published names only, no rank or score of their own.

category.description: A category id from list_categories, e.g. "exchange" or "hardware_wallet" (a ranked id), or one of its notRanked ids, which every tool answers with status "not_ranked".

limit.description: How many rows, from the top (default 10).

tools.name: get_ranking_for_country
tools.description: The category's products as a reader in one country sees them: those available there, in order, with each one's published score and rank beside it. When nothing passes the country's availability filter, resultMode is "fallback" and the rows are the published order, none confirmed for that country.

category.description: A category id from list_categories, e.g. "exchange" or "hardware_wallet" (a ranked id), or one of its notRanked ids, which every tool answers with status "not_ranked".

limit.description: How many rows, from the top (default 10).

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: For one category (and optionally one product id): each criterion, its weight, and per product the score with the quoted passage, its source URL and the day it was read.

category.description: A category id from list_categories, e.g. "exchange" or "hardware_wallet" (a ranked id), or one of its notRanked ids, which every tool answers with status "not_ranked".

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Checks a signed receipt (as ChainChoice serves it, or an issuer envelope) against the keys ChainChoice publishes: whether its content hash matches and its signature is valid. The same verifier as POST /api/v1/verify.

receipt.description: The receipt JSON, with its signature.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Reads a query exactly as ChainChoice's search bars do (the same resolver as the homepage, the navigation field and the command palette) and returns that reading: the page it opens (a category's ranked list with the country, monthly volume, sort and filters read from the words, a product's verdict, a two-product compare, a guide), or the question it asks with at most three options, each with the page it opens; `answer`, the card the bars show before a page opens (the published #1 or the named product, its ChainChoice Score and rank, the margin, why it leads, its main trade-off, the list's page and a link to watch it), every figure from the published ranking; `notRanked` instead, with `answer` null, when the reading opens a list that is not ranked right now (its line, the products it tracks A to Z, when we check again, its page and at most two ranked lists that do a similar job: no rank and no score); `readBy` when a model read a sentence the rules could not (only while ChainChoice's model tier is on and released by its measured eval); `followUps`, the follow-ups the bars offer under the answer (why not the runner-up or the leader, the top two side by side, only the ones serving the reader's country, the amount written once as a monthly volume), each as words this tool reads, from published names only and none for a list not ranked right now, a question or a guide; plus `open`, the homepage address that runs the same search. `country` applies a reader's country to a ranked list when the words name none; a country in the words wins. Nobody pays for a place in any answer.

query.description: The words a reader would type, e.g. "kraken or coinbase" or "best exchange for a German user".

tools.name: hand_off
tools.description: Once the reader has agreed to go to a provider (consent: true), returns what to hand over: the provider's own address as ChainChoice's catalog records it (never a referral or affiliate link; ChainChoice earns nothing from it), the product's published rank and ChainChoice Score, the reader's country, amount and cadence (once, the default, or monthly), the ranked list's page with that setup, whether the provider serves that country, and a receipt signed with ChainChoice's published key (check it with verify_receipt) recording exactly what was handed over. A provider that does not serve the reader's country is not handed off: handedOff is false with the reason. Nor is a provider whose link ChainChoice's own pages do not show a reader in that country (information only: the United States, the United Kingdom, every market not yet reviewed, and a reader whose country is not given; a tool keeps the neutral link the pages show): handedOff is false, with the page's sentence as the reason and ChainChoice's page in place of the provider's address. It does not open anything, log the reader or change any ranking.

category.description: A category id from list_categories, e.g. "exchange" or "hardware_wallet" (a ranked id), or one of its notRanked ids, which every tool answers with status "not_ranked".

product.description: A product id from get_ranking or a search answer.

consent.description: true only once the reader has agreed to be sent to this provider.

country.description: The reader's country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "DE" (optional).

vol.description: The reader's amount (optional): one purchase, unless cadence is "monthly".

cadence.description: What vol is: "once", one purchase (the default, as the site opens on €500 once), or "monthly", a month's buying (optional).

query.description: The reader's words, if the hand-off follows a search (optional, kept in the receipt).

tools.name: check_mica_status
tools.description: For one of the providers ChainChoice keeps a MiCA check page for and one country: whether ESMA's interim MiCA register, as ChainChoice last read it, lists the provider's entity for that EEA state (answer yes, no, not_applicable for a product outside MiCA's scope, or not_in_eea), why (home state, passport, Article 60 notification, ended, not yet in force, not listed, no entity), every entity that covers it with its LEI and authority, the register's read time and source, and the page anchor that prints the same cell. It is the register fact only: whether the provider's app accepts a reader also depends on its own terms. No ranking, score or paid link.

provider.description: A provider id or name from ChainChoice's MiCA check pages, e.g. "bybit" or "Bybit".

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (EL is read as Greece), e.g. "MT", or an EEA state's English name, e.g. "Malta".
